Loss report: gha -> argo
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner (Argo schedules pods; only a platform label can carry a node selector)
[external] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.push: EventSource webhook secret (Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token must exist and match the GitHub webhook; the repository owner and name are placeholders; set them in the EventSource)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.shell: container command sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the container runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.pull_request (the trigger accepts a pull request from the same repository only; a fork would run its code with every secret)
